description: Structured backlog of systemic dispatcher findings produced by Phase 8 self-review (TEMP_PHASE_8). Upsert by finding_id; bump recurrence + last_seen when a finding re-appears. Do not rewrite from scratch.

findings.title: Subagents run git ops in the dispatcher working tree instead of a dedicated worktree, leaving local commits ahead of remote
evidence: Phase 5 reviewer for PR#661 ran git ops in /home/user/property-management, creating a local commit ahead of remote
PR#640 rebaser likely did the same
Recurring issue tracked as #7
findings.proposed_fix: Hard-isolate every subagent to its own `git worktree add` under .claude/worktrees/<task>; have the dispatcher refuse to spawn any subagent that would operate in the dispatcher CWD.

findings.title: Concurrent subagent pushes to dev create rapid version-bump cycles and empty the dispatcher Phase 6 commit
evidence: Version churn 0.2.964 -> 0.2.968 in a single run from concurrent subagent pushes
Dispatcher Phase 6 commit was 'nothing to commit' because subagents pre-empted all changes
findings.proposed_fix: Serialize state writes behind a single owner: subagents return diffs, only the dispatcher commits/pushes assignments + version.

findings.title: Both rebaser subagent and dispatcher increment rebase_attempts, double-counting the counter
evidence: rebase_attempts landed on 2 instead of 1; caught and fixed manually
findings.proposed_fix: Assign a single owner for rebase_attempts mutation (either rebaser OR dispatcher, never both) and document it in the rebaser contract.

findings.title: Two dispatcher cycles overlap with no lock, forcing a mid-run reset + re-run on push conflict
evidence: A parallel run pushed state (generated=2026-05-28T12:32:35Z, 137 archived) mid-transition; reset to origin/dev and re-ran
findings.proposed_fix: Take a run-level advisory lock at Phase 1 (dispatcher.lock ref/row or GitHub deployment lock); abort fast if held.

findings.title: Phase 5.5 merger strands approved PRs on diverse blockers (ci-fail, needs-human-review, draft, ci-unknown, dirty) with no per-blocker routing
evidence: 5 approved PRs unmergeable: #633 ci-fail, #639 needs-human-review, #641 draft+needs-human-review, #643 ci-unknown/0-checks, #640 dirty
0 merged by dispatcher; approved pool only grows
findings.proposed_fix: Per-blocker routing in Phase 5.5: ci-fail -> Phase 5.7 respawn; needs-human-review -> explicit human-escalation tag + stop; dirty -> auto-rebase; ci-unknown/0-checks -> re-trigger CI or wait, don't strand.

findings.title: PRs with zero reported CI checks are neither pass nor fail and the merger has no rule, leaving them stuck
evidence: PR#643 had CI=unknown / 0 checks; merger silently left it stuck
findings.proposed_fix: Add an explicit ci-unknown/0-checks branch to the merge gate: re-trigger CI (or wait + recheck) rather than treating absent checks as indeterminate-and-stranded.

findings.title: Resuming from a compacted context forces re-derivation of every phase decision via live API, slow and divergence-prone
evidence: Run resumed from a summary after context compaction; all phase decisions re-derived via GitHub API checks
findings.proposed_fix: Persist a small per-run decisions ledger in management state so a post-compaction resume reloads decisions instead of re-deriving them.

findings.title: Suffix-variant task_ids (-impl/-fix/-v2) bypass the dedup gate and open a second PR for the same gap
evidence: gap-82-4-swiftui-listing-detail (PR#641) and gap-82-4-swiftui-listing-detail-impl (PR#644) both in review simultaneously
Phase 7 dup-skip log keys on exact task_id; -impl variant slipped through and got its own PR
Prior run (005d515) dup-skipped gap-82-4 against #641,#644 — both already existed
findings.proposed_fix: Normalize task_id by stripping trailing -impl|-fix|-v\d+ before the open-PR / same-epic conflict check, or key dedup on the gap-id prefix (gap-82-4-*) so suffix variants collide.

findings.title: Fire-and-forget implementer spawns lose the row<->PR link, leaving orphaned PRs back-filled in Phase 2
evidence: Phase 2 reconciliation discovered 4 orphaned PRs this run (#685, #686, #687, #641) with no assignment rows
Reconciliation/orphan noise present in 2 of the 3 visible runs
findings.proposed_fix: Write the assignment row (status=in-progress, branch set) BEFORE firing the implementer, so a PR can never be orphaned. Keep Phase 2 reconciliation as a safety net only.

findings.title: Post-merge review cadence gate uses file mtime, which a fresh clone resets to now — gate never fires after a clone
evidence: Phase 7: 'Post-merge: skipped (mtime < 24h — fresh clone reset mtime)'
findings.proposed_fix: Persist last_post_merge_review_at in management state (e.g. assignments.json meta) and gate Phase 6 on that timestamp rather than file mtime — immune to clone resets.

findings.title: Local dev branch drifts behind origin/dev, forcing a mid-run reset + re-run
evidence: Phase 7 note: 'Local dev was 50 commits behind origin/dev; reset to origin/dev and re-ran.'
2026-05-28T13:41Z: parallel run pushed state mid-transition; reset to origin/dev and re-ran phases
findings.proposed_fix: At run start, git fetch and (when N commits behind) reset --hard origin/dev before any gate, so timing-sensitive phases run against current base on the first pass.

findings.title: Review->merge conversion is bursty: both merge attempts failed, 0 merged vs 10 in review
evidence: Merge attempts: PR#633 merged=false ci-failed; PR#639 merged=false needs-human-review
Merged-now trend across visible runs: 4 -> 11 -> 0; in-review pool 14 -> 11 -> 12
2026-05-28T13:41Z: dispatcher merged 0 of 5 approved PRs (all blocked); only human merges (#686, #687) drained the pool
findings.proposed_fix: Track per-PR merge-blocker reason (ci-failed vs needs-human-review) as a metric; consider Phase 5.7-style auto-respawn on ci-failed and explicit human-escalation tagging for needs-human-review so the review pool drains steadily.

findings.title: Commit-subject metrics trailer omits dup-skip volume, undercounting run activity for trend reads
evidence: Subject: C2 R4 M2 X0 F0 A12 — but Phase 7 recorded 4 dup-skips not surfaced in the trailer
Prior report (2026-05-28T09-47-03Z) already noted metrics-trailer drift (X2 vs 4 actually merged)
findings.proposed_fix: Recompute the metrics trailer after Phase 5.5 (post-merge) and add a dup-skip count token so commit subjects match the Phase 7 summary.
